competing_explanation: The 30-day figure may come from an outdated policy, a promotional exception, or a different product category rather than the current standard-item policy.
hypothesis_statement: The current policy for standard items provides a full-refund return window of 30 days from the date of delivery or receipt.
refutation_criterion: Current authoritative policy text specifies a different return window, applies only to non-standard items, excludes full refunds, or states that the 30-day window is no longer current.
